parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request and retrieve the remaining entries.

parameters.name: ResourceArn
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the shared resource.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the shared resource.

parameters.name: ResourceOwner
parameters.description:
The owner of the resource share.

- Self: Queries the principals that are associated with the resource shares you created.

- OtherAccounts: Queries the resource shares that other accounts created and shared with you, and the owners of these resource shares.

parameters.name: ResourceShareIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of resource shares.

The value of N can be from 1 to 5. You can specify up to 5 resource share IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the shared resource.

For more information about the resource types that can be shared, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing](~~450526~~).
